title: KAFKA-20416: Clear consumed offsets on task close
body:
A corrupted EOS task is wiped and revived as the same `StreamTask`
object, but `consumedOffsets` survived the close. For a `KTable` that
uses its source topic as its changelog, the next checkpoint stamped
those pre-corruption offsets onto the empty store. The store then looked
fully restored, and the task ran with its `KTable` missing data.
Clearing consumedOffsets in close() makes the wiped store restore from
its actual position.

The integration test in this PR fails without this fix.

Reviewers: Lucas Brutschy <lbrutschy@confluent.io>
